structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 fund. 750 ₪ a month for 15 years means I put in 135,000 ₪ and end up with about 179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום", after fees and tax. That assumes 7% a year and 2% inflation, both just numbers the site picked ("פרמטר של האתר").

stuck.why: I tapped it twice and nothing changed on the screen. No number, no popup. I only found the 2% by accident, when I tapped the big 179,889 ₪ figure.
I typed 750 but the slider says 800. I wasn't sure which one the result uses. The popup later showed 750, so that was fine.

findings.what: The "אינפלציה" button does nothing visible when you tap it. The 2% assumption only shows up inside a popup on the result number.
"בכסף של היום" is written, but nowhere near it does it say what inflation was assumed.
The slider jumps to 800 when you type 750, so you can't tell which value counts.
Lots of fee colours in the bar chart that I can't match without reading the legend.
